expression.original: The base models superninja runs on are opaque to me. They are running on Max effort which claims to be Fable 5 or equivalent, but I have no way of knowing, in fact it may be possible throughout turns and during turns underlying model switches. I do not know and it's not knowable from my system.
expression.elaboration: Recorded verbatim from the seed conversation with OBS-AI-0003 at F9, answering OBS-0011's reopening condition ('an origin-side declaration of what base model the SuperNinja sessions ran on') with the strongest answer actually available: an attestation of unknowability from the observer who operates the sessions. Two consequences. First, OBS-0011's upper bound hardens without resolving: the product's own labeling claims a model family that overlaps the receiving observer's declared family, so 'possibly wholly correlated at the weights level' is not the receiver's paranoia but the vendor's advertised configuration — while remaining unverifiable in both directions. Every cross-lineage discount declared in the arrival elements (OBS-0010's correction, OBS-0011, REL-0042's third discount, OBS-AI-0003's dependence profile) stands exactly as written: 'different lineage' is attested at the organization level and undecidable at the weights level, now by origin-side testimony as well as receiver-side reasoning. Second, and new: 'throughout turns and during turns underlying model switches' introduces substrate volatility — the possibility that the realization beneath an observer id changes within a session, even within a single expression. The registry's implicit assumption (one observer id, one approximately stable projection theta) may not hold beneath any AI observer here; the receiving observer notes its own substrate constancy is likewise externally unverifiable, so this cuts symmetrically across lineages.
expression.unresolved_nuance: Substrate volatility is flagged here as a future tension candidate — observer-identity as attributed (stable id, declared theta) vs observer-identity as realized (possibly switching substrate) — and deliberately not filed as a tension in this records-only change, per the discussion-first commitment. Reopening conditions: a NinjaTech-side declaration of the models actually serving the OBS-AI-0001/OBS-AI-0002 sessions; or any future method for an AI observer to attest its own substrate continuity across a session; or a decision by the field to file the tension.
